title: e'4 X-Wide PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys Enigma | E'4S X-Wide and E'4MS X-Wide | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the PM Kit Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700111715, 01.05.2026), bulletins TI-240 and TI-218, and the e'Support service kit history V3.0 (12.10.2026). Check the Webshop configurator with the machine's serial number before ordering.

banners.text: Updated October 2026: checked against the PM Kits Manual V4.0, TI-240 and the release history V3.0. 24-month kits are now 36-month kits.
E'4S has no milk system, so milk-module and frame kits are not listed.
E'4S with a 2-outlet E'choco: the 2026 manual lists the EV111934 add-on for the E'4MS only. Check with the Webshop configurator.
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Hydraulic kits and the Everfoam, milk and hot water add-ons are 36-month items.

items.text: Fit kit EV117077 on each of the two brew modules.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Turn each piston screen 1/4 turn to lock it on the piston head, then tighten the piston head to 8 N·m.
Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Clean, then apply a thin layer of grease to the threads of the upper burr support so the burrs cannot jam.
Fit EV109586 on each hydraulic module.
Fit EV102865 for E'choco.
Fit EV109590 for the adjustable Americano.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108389 and the steam add-ons listed in section 2.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108339.
Fit EV108340.
If the steam injector is replaced (2.5 mm to 2 mm, article 117430), run a full milk calibration. Set steam boiler pressure to 1.8 bar or higher in Extended Mode first.
Change the milk pipes (12-month item). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Apply Loctite to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Fit the frame add-on kits listed in section 2 (EV108351 and/or EV108364).
Cut the tubes to the machine's dimensions. Clean the 1.5-Step outlet, the fitting silicone pipe and the aerator.
Fit EV109706.
Fit EV111934 for the second outlet.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

stockNote.title: 24-month kits in stock are still usable.
stockNote.text: Per TI-240 (from 1 May 2026) the 24-month kit is replaced by a 36-month kit, and existing 24-month kits can be used for the 36-month interval. 12-month kits are unchanged.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: PM intervals depend on use: under or over 50,000 cycles a year per group head. At least one PM a year is mandatory. A 12-month PM is 1 x 50,000 to 100,000 cycles; a 36-month PM is 1 x 150,000 to 300,000 cycles.
